errors.status_tier_rule: A JSON-RPC error carries HTTP 400 when the request is rejected while validating the transport envelope (unparseable or non-object body, batch array, client-to-server response, missing or mismatched required MCP headers, missing params._meta, unsupported protocol version), and HTTP 200 once the envelope validated and the method dispatched (unknown method/tool/resource/prompt, missing or invalid params, invalid cursor, missing client capability, MRTR request-state faults).

normalisation.unordered_collections: sort by declared deterministic key; reordering applies only where a golden declares that key, and never to an array whose order a golden pins, including catalog arrays, SSE event streams, http-contract observation lists, and evaluated_checks, which all compare in document order
normalisation.floats: round only when a test declares precision
